g.text: The norm counts every Fourier term
touching each link, including large supports.
All physical states sit inside the full
link space with the same ground state.
An ambient lower bound covers them all.

g.text: Safe threshold: r ≤ 1/96 in two spatial dimensions; r ≤ 1/192 in three. This is a fixed-lattice result; continuum existence and mass-gap survival remain open.
